title: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff dismisses concerns of a "SaaS-pocalypse", saying companies like Anthropic use "a lot of SaaS because it just got better with agents" (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff dismisses concerns of a “SaaS-pocalypse”, saying companies like Anthropic use “a lot of SaaS because it just got better with agents” — Shares in company that sells software as a service fall after it projects revenue below Wall Street's expectations
contentText:
Financial Times :

Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff dismisses concerns of a “SaaS-pocalypse”, saying companies like Anthropic use “a lot of SaaS because it just got better with agents”   —  Shares in company that sells software as a service fall after it projects revenue below Wall Street's expectations
